heading: Pampered in Paradise
body_html:
Decadent Delight

SALTAY SIGNATURE TREATMENT

  • Step out of the world and transport yourself into your very own sanctuary where fragrant scents and rhythmic frequencies create a space for you to relax, and let go.

  • Heated stones are placed on specific points of the body while botanical infused oils are lathered in to encourage you to connect to the rhythms of your heart.

  • Herbal bundles are used to stretch your muscles and release tension while your system comes into balance through gentle touch.

  • Session concludes with warm compresses being applied to your energy centers while jade stones are combed through the top of your head and hair to allow for a decadent feeling to wash your being. Your body will be lightly spritzed with a fragrant cool mist, bringing you back to present time and space. Perfect for honeymooners, couples, celebratory times, friends, and more.
